strings: Collateral Factor
Yadda kowane abubuwan ajiya na vault-token Collateral Factor ke mayar da ƙimar matsayin LP zuwa damar aron GHO akan Avana Borrow Spoke.

Yadda Yake Aiki

Yawan ƙimar matsayin LP da ke tallafa wa bashin GHO.

Ƙimantawa da iyakokin aro sun bambanta. LPOracle yana ba da rahoton ƙimar ruwan kuɗin da ke bayan kowane vault token ba tare da ragi ba. Sannan Collateral Factor na reserve yana tsayar da yawan wannan ƙimar da ke tallafa wa bashi. Tsarin lissafin su ne LPCollateralFactor = min(Token0CF, Token1CF) × PoolRiskFactor da BorrowingCapacity = LPPositionValue × LPCollateralFactor.
Matsayi a kasuwannin da aka amince da su kaɗai ake karɓa. RiskModule yana karɓar pool na Uniswap v2 da aka amince da shi, ko pool, matakin kuɗi da kewayo na Uniswap v3 da aka amince da su.

Factor ɗin yana farawa daga Collateral Factor mafi ƙanƙanta na tokens biyu na pool. Sannan ma'aunin haɗarin pool yana rage shi sau ɗaya. Ma'aunin haɗarin pool yana nuna kewayo, tasirin canjin farashi, zurfin pool da kuɗaɗen liquidation da ake tsammani.

Gauntlet yana ba da shawarar factor na farawa wanda zai iya yin ƙasa har zuwa 0.25× na factor mafi ƙanƙanta na tokens na ƙasa lokacin aron kadarar da ba ɗaya daga cikin tokens na pool ba, kamar GHO a kan WETH/USDC. Gudanarwa ce ke tsayar da ƙimomin kowace kasuwa.

Wannan misali ne kuma ba ya nuna sigogin kasuwa. Ana ƙimanta GHO da USDC a $1. Matsayin WETH/USDC mai cikakken kewayo na $100,000 ana wakiltarsa da raka'ar tushe ɗaya ta vault-token a kowace raka'ar ruwan kuɗi, wanda jimillar ƙimarsa ta kai $100,000. Tare da Collateral Factor mafi ƙanƙanta na ƙasa na 70% da ma'aunin haɗarin pool na 50%, LP Collateral Factor shi ne 35%. Ƙarfin aro shi ne GHO 35,000.
Collateral Risk ba ragi ba ne. Yana tsayar da ƙarin ribar mai aro. Ƙarfin aro kuma ya dogara ne da bashin da ake da shi, iyakokin fallasa, ruwan kuɗin GHO da ake da shi da binciken oracle.
• Gudanarwa ce ke tsayar da ma'aunin haɗarin pool da Collateral Factor na kowace kasuwa.
• Kowane nau'in kasuwa (Stable LP, Correlated LP da Blue-chip/stable LP) yana da nasa Borrow Spoke, sigogi da iyakoki.
Karanta wannan tare da Tsarin Lafiya da Tsarin Liquidation lokacin gina kayan aikin sa ido.
Yadda Collateral Factor ke mayar da ƙimar vault token zuwa ƙarfin aron GHO.

Matsakaicin darajar jingina, bayan Abubuwan Haɗin kai, da fitattun GHO bashi akan Avana Borrow Spoke.

Ma'aunin lafiya yana kwatanta ƙimar jingina, bayan Collateral Factor na kowane reserve, da bashin GHO da ba a biya ba a kan Borrow Spoke na Avana. LPOracle yana ƙimanta vault tokens ba tare da ragi ba. Haɗarin pool yana rage ƙarfin aro ta hanyar Collateral Factor.
Idan ma'aunin lafiya ya faɗi ƙasa da 1, asusun yana cancantar liquidation. Don abin da ke faruwa bayan haka, duba
Tsarin Liquidation
Ƙarfin aro shi ne jimillar jinginar vault-token na asusu a kan Borrow Spoke guda. Ana ƙimanta kowane vault token a farashin kasuwarsa da nasa Collateral Factor.

Borrow Spoke yana lissafa lafiya ta amfani da daidaitaccen lissafin Aave V4. Lambar sama (numerator) ita ce ƙimar vault tokens a farashin LPOracle, wanda aka ninka da Collateral Factor na kowane reserve.
healthFactor = (collateralValue × collateralFactor) / outstandingDebt

Wannan misali ne kuma ba ya nuna sigogin kasuwa. Matsayin WETH/USDC na $100,000 tare da Collateral Factor na 35% da bashin GHO 25,000 yana farawa a ma'aunin lafiya na 1.40. Ma'aunin lafiya yana kaiwa 1.00 idan ƙimar jingina ta faɗi da kusan 29%, zuwa kusan $71,400. A ƙarƙashin samfurin cikakken kewayo mai sauƙi, wannan faɗuwar tana daidai da faɗuwar ETH da kusan 49%.
Lafiya:
ƙimar lafiya ta wuce 1 tare da kari. A cikin misali na bayyanawa, hanyar haɗin tana iyakance sabon aron zuwa buɗe ƙimar lafiya na 1.10.
Kulawa:
ma'aunin lafiya har yanzu yana sama da 1 amma rarar tsaro ƙarama ce. Biyan bashi ko ƙarin jingina da aka amince da ita yana ƙara wannan rarar tsaro.
Za a iya liquidation:
matsalar lafiya tana kasa da 1, kuma mai kula da aka amince da shi zai iya warware asusun ta hanyar LPVaultSwap.
Iƙirarin faɗakarwa na fuska na iya bayyana kafin ma'aunin lafiya ya kai 1 don ba masu amfani lokaci su ɗauki mataki.

Lokacin da lafiya ta yi rauni, mai aro na iya biyan GHO a kowane lokaci ta AaveAdapter sai dai idan an dakatar da shi. Mai aro na iya kuma kiran kwangilolin kai tsaye ba tare da frontend na Avana ba. Ƙara jingina da aka amince da ita shi ma yana ƙara rarar tsaro.

Da zarar ma'aunin lafiya ya faɗi ƙasa da 1, keepers da aka amince da su na iya kiran LPVaultSwap. Sasantawa ta ɓangare tana cire ruwan kuɗin da ake buƙata don dawo da lafiya kaɗai. Sasantawa ta cikakken matsayi tana biyan bashin kuma tana mayar wa mai aro duk wata rara.
Aron da yawa yana rage lafiya saboda bashi yana karuwa a kan abin da ya dace.
Biya bashin yana inganta lafiya nan take. Biyan bashi yana ci gaba ko da allahn shiriya ya hanƙa sabon aro.
Jingina ƙarin matsayi da aka amince da su yana ƙara tazarar aro idan RiskModule ya karɓe su.
Janyewar jinginar gida ana yarda da ita ne kawai idan asusun yana cikin koshin lafiya. Ana hana janyewar da ke ƙara haɗari idan binciken TWAP ya kasa ko kuma bayanan Chainlink sun tsufa.

Borrow Spoke
Ƙa'ida ta Aave V4 Spoke, mallakin Aave DAO, inda vault tokens ke ba da GHO aro ga wata rukuni kasuwa ɗaya.

Borrow Spoke na Avana daidaitaccen Aave V4 Spoke ne wanda ba a gyara ba, mallakar Aave DAO. Yana riƙe da reserves na vault-token na rukunin kasuwa guda. Yana aiwatar da Collateral Factor, Collateral Risk da sigogin liquidation na kowane reserve. Borrow Spokes suna ba da rancen GHO.

Avana yana da rukunin kasuwa uku, kowanne da nasa Borrow Spoke, sigogi da iyakoki. Stable LP yana haɗa stablecoins biyu (wanda ake la'akari: USDC/USDT). Correlated LP yana haɗa kadarorin da ke motsi tare (wanda ake la'akari: wstETH/WETH). Blue-chip/stable LP yana haɗa babbar kadara da stablecoin (wanda ake la'akari: WETH/USDC). Har yanzu ana tantance waɗanda ake la'akari da su.

Masu aro ba sa kiran Borrow Spoke kai tsaye. AaveAdapter shi ne mashigar mai aro zuwa Avana. Yana daidaita kowace Jinginarwa (Pledge) tare da LP Vault da Collateralization Module. Sannan yana ƙirƙirar vault tokens kuma yana samar da su ta Position Proxy na mai aro a matsayin jingina. Aro, biyan bashi da cirewa suma suna bi ta AaveAdapter. Lambar aiki da ta keɓanta ga Avana tana nan a cikin kwangilolin Avana, kuma Spoke yana gudanar da daidaitaccen lissafin Aave V4.

Mai ajiya yana jingina matsayin WETH/USDC mai cikakken kewayo na $100,000. Ruwan kuɗin yana nan a cikin pool. Collateralization Module yana ƙirƙirar raka'ar tushe ɗaya ta vault-token a kowace raka'ar ruwan kuɗin matsayin, wanda LPOracle ke ƙimanta jimillarsa a $100,000.

Tare da Collateral Factor mafi ƙanƙanta na ƙasa na 70% da ma'aunin haɗarin pool na 50%, Collateral Factor na reserve shi ne 35%. Wannan yana ba da ƙarfin aro na GHO 35,000. Manhajar tana taƙaita aron buɗewa zuwa ma'aunin lafiya na 1.10, kusan GHO 31,800.
Mai aro yana cire GHO 25,000 daga Avana Hub, wanda ke ba da ma'aunin lafiya na farko na 1.40. Waɗannan lambobi misali ne, ba sigogin kasuwa ba.

Mai aro na iya jingina ƙarin matsayi da aka amince da su daga baya. Kowace kasuwa tana da nata vault token. Ƙarfin aro kuma ya dogara ne da iyakokin fallasa, ruwan kuɗin GHO da ke akwai da binciken oracle.

Avana yana da matakai uku. Avana Hub yana riƙe da layin bashi na GHO, kuma Borrow Spokes na Avana suna riƙe da reserves na vault-token. Aave DAO ne ya mallaki duka biyun. Kwangilolin Avana na kansa (LP Vault, AaveAdapter, LPOracle, RiskModule, CollateralizationModule, LPVaultSwap, AMMSettlementAdapters da AvanaConfig) suna kula da riƙo, ƙimantawa da sasantawa a wajen Aave V4. Avana ba ya kwafa, yin fork ko gyara lambar Aave V4.

— AaveAdapter yana ƙirƙirar vault tokens don rancen ruwa da kuma samar da su ta hanyar Wakar Matsayin mai aro.
Bashi yana ja Avana Hub na ruwa
— da zarar Colateral Factor, cap da oracle checks sun wuce, Spoke yana zana GHO daga Avana Hub a cikin hular zane.
Bashi yana ƙaruwa a ƙimar aro
— BorrowingRate = BaseRate × (1 + UserRiskPremium). Aave V4 yana sabunta ƙarin farashin kan aro, cirewa, canjin jingina da kuma akan buƙata.
Liquidation idan an buƙata
— lokacin da abubuwan lafiya su fadi kasa da 1, mai kula da aka amince da shi yana kiran LPVaultSwap, wanda ke warware matsayin a karkashin yanayin biyan kasuwa.

Borrow Spoke ba ya riƙe reserves na masu ba da rance. Avana Hub, daidaitaccen Aave V4 Hub mallakar Aave DAO, yana riƙe da ruwan kuɗin GHO da lissafin bashi. Spoke yana aiwatar da sigogin haɗari na vault-token.

Aave bayanan tsarin, Avana ilimi, da lissafin matsayi a cikin ɗaya keɓaɓɓen haɗin gwiwar tattaunawa.

Ask AI ita ce hanyar tattaunawa ta Avana don tambayoyi game da kasuwanni da matsayi. Buƙata tana ambaton kasuwa, kadara, ko matsayin da za a bincika. Tambayoyin bibiya na iya fayyace bayanan shigarwa da zato. Amsar tana bayyana bayanan da ake da su. Binciken protocol ne har yanzu ke tantance ko ma'amalar da aka nema za ta iya ci gaba.
Avana yana tallafa wa aron GHO a kan zaɓaɓɓun LP tokens na Uniswap v2 da matsayin Uniswap v3 a Ethereum mainnet.

Tambayoyin da suka shafi walat sun dogara ne da walat da network da aka zaɓa. Bayanan kasuwa na jama'a suna bayyana kasuwar. Ragowar kuɗi da matsayi na wani asusu ne a kan wani network na musamman. Ragowar kuɗi, farashi, ko hanya da ta ɓace tana barin lissafin da ke da alaƙa da ita bai cika ba.

Ask AI yana amfani da Aave MCP tare da tsarin dawo da bayanai da aiwatar da samfur na Avana. Model Context Protocol yana ba da tsarin haɗin kai ga kayan aiki na waje. Uwar garken Aave yana bayyana bayanai na kasuwa v3 da v4, ciki har da ajiyoyi, ƙimar, samun kuɗi, da tsarin yarjejeniya. Bayanan Aave suna riƙe da network ɗinsu, sigar protocol, da mahallin reserve. Ba sa nuna cewa wata kadara tana samuwa a kasuwar Avana. Tsarin samar da amsa mai taimakon nemo bayanai (RAG) na Avana yana bincika ilimin protocol na Avana don nemo bayanan da suka shafi tambaya. Yana samar da waɗannan bayanai a matsayin mahalli ga amsar. Sassan da aka nemo suna bayyana tsarin gine-gine, ƙa'idojin jingina, tsarin liquidation, da ayyukan samfur. Kowane sashe ya ƙunshi bayanan tushe, don haka ana iya bibiyar bayanin zuwa takardunsa. RAG yana samar da ilimin protocol, ba farashi kai tsaye ba. Ƙimar riba da ragowar kuɗi suna fitowa daga tushen bayanai da suka dace.

Bayanan matsayi da hanyoyin lissafi na Avana na kansa ne ke samar da mahallin da ya keɓanta ga samfur. Tambayar aro na iya haɗa bayanan kasuwar Aave, bayanan da aka nemo game da jinginar LP, da lissafin bashin GHO da ƙarfin aron matsayin da aka zaɓa. Kowane bayanin shigarwa yana da rawar daban. Sashen takardu yana bayyana ƙa'ida. Amsar kasuwa tana ba da rahoton yanayin da aka lura. Lissafin matsayi yana amfani da bayanan shigarwa da suka dace a kan asusu ko yanayi.

Kwatancen kasuwa na iya haɗawa da ƙimar ribar aron GHO (BaseRate × (1 + UserRiskPremium)), GHO da ke akwai a Avana Hub, da Collateral Factor na kowace kasuwa. Ribar kuɗaɗe da aka nuna bayanin shigarwa ɗaya ne kawai. Ribar bashi da canje-canje a matsayin LP suma suna shafar sakamakon. Masu aro har yanzu suna ɗaukar asarar wucin gadi, haɗarin farashi, da haɗarin liquidation. Tushen bayanai, lokutan rikodi, da zaton yanayi suna ba da mahallin da ake buƙata don fassara kwatancen.

Ku ari GHO daga Avana Hub a kan jinginar LP da kuka bayar. Borrow Spokes suna ba da rancen GHO.

Da zarar an samar da vault tokens kuma an kunna su a matsayin jingina, mai aro na iya aron GHO har zuwa ƙarfin aron asusun da ke akwai. GHO tana fitowa daga Avana Hub ta Borrow Spoke na Avana na kasuwar. Buƙatar tana bi ta AaveAdapter da Position Proxy na mai aro. GHO da aka aro tana zuwa walat ɗin mai aro.

Riba tana ƙara bashin da ba a biya ba a tsawon lokaci. Saboda haka ma'aunin lafiya na iya faɗuwa ko da ƙimar jingina ba ta canza ba. Ƙarfin aro da ba a yi amfani da shi ba rarar tsaro ce daga ƙaruwar bashi da kuma canje-canje a ƙimar jingina.

Kowane kasuwa yana da nata vault token, Borrow Spoke, Factor ɗin Rashin Biyan Lamuni, da iyakoki. Matsayi masu girma iri ɗaya a cikin daban-daban pools na iya haka don tallafawa adadi daban-daban na GHO.
AaveAdapter yana duba farashin farko. Ana hana sabon aro idan TWAP na pool ya fita daga iyakar da aka yarda daga farashin Chainlink, ko idan bayanin Chainlink ya tsufa ko ba daidai ba ne.
Adadin aro dole ne ya dace da sauran ƙarfin rancen ku: ƙimar matsayi wanda aka ninka ta hanyar Factor's Conlateral Factor, ƙarancin bashi.
Dole ne Avana Hub ya kasance da GHO a ƙarƙashin layin bashinsa. Dole ne iyakokin cirewa na Hub da iyakokin Spoke su ma su ba da izinin aron.
Dole ne asusunku ya kasance cikin ƙoshin lafiya bayan an ƙara sabon bashin. A wani misali na bayani, manhajar tana taƙaita sabon aro zuwa ma'aunin lafiya na buɗewa na 1.10.

Ma'aunin lafiya yana kwatanta ƙimar jingina, bayan an aiwatar da Collateral Factor na reserve, da bashin GHO da ba a biya ba. LPOracle yana ba da rahoton ƙimar ruwan kuɗin da ke bayan kowane vault token ba tare da ragi ba. Collateral Factor yana tsayar da yawan wannan ƙimar da za ta iya tallafa wa bashi.
healthFactor = (lpPositionValue × lpCollateralFactor) / outstandingDebt

Misali, matsayin WETH/USDC mai cikakken kewayo na $100,000 tare da Collateral Factor na 35% da GHO 25,000 da aka aro yana da ma'aunin lafiya na 1.40. Ƙasa da 1.00, matsayin yana cancantar liquidation. Don cikakken tsarin lissafi, duba
health factor

keɓaɓɓen Position Proxy yana riƙe da matsayin Aave na kowane mai aro, don haka ajiya, aro, biyan bashi, da cirewa duka suna bi ta matakan sarrafawa na Avana.
Zane Hub:
Borrow Spoke yana cire GHO daga Avana Hub. Hub yana riƙe da layin bashi na GHO mai iyaka da aka ware ta hanyar GHO Reserve. Borrow Spokes da aka amince da su kaɗai ne ke da ikon cire GHO.
Yawan riba:

BorrowingRate = BaseRate × (1 + UserRiskPremium). Misali, ribar tushe ta 4.5% tare da ƙarin ribar haɗari na 50% tana bayar da 6.75%. Idan akwai matsayin jingina da yawa, ƙarin ribar matsakaicin ma'auni ne (weighted average). Aave V4 yana sabunta shi lokacin aro, cirewa, canjin jingina, da kuma idan an nema.
Borrow Spokes suna ba da rancen GHO. Tana fitowa daga Avana Hub, wanda layin bashi na GHO mai iyaka ke ba shi kuɗi. Kowane ƙari ga layin bashin yana ƙarƙashin sharuɗɗa da amincewar gudanarwa.
Ana aron kadarori ban da GHO ta Lend Spoke na Avana, wanda gudanarwar Aave ke amincewa da shi daban.

Ƙarfin aro shi ne ƙimar matsayi wanda aka ninka da Collateral Factor na reserve, inda LPCollateralFactor = min(Token0CF, Token1CF) × PoolRiskFactor. Misali, idan mafi ƙanƙanta daga cikin factors biyu na ƙasa ya kasance 70% kuma ma'aunin haɗarin pool ya kasance 50%, Collateral Factor shi ne 35%. A wannan yanayi, matsayin $100,000 yana tallafa wa bashi har zuwa GHO 35,000. Gudanarwa ce ke tsayar da sigogin kowace kasuwa.

Ƙarfin aro kuma ya dogara ne da bashin da ake da shi, iyakokin fallasa, ruwan kuɗin GHO da ake da shi, da binciken oracle. Yayin da bashi ke kusantar ƙarfin aro, tazarar da ta rage don canjin farashi ko riba tana raguwa. Kafin ku ƙayyade girman aro, ku karanta waɗannan shafuka:

Waɗanne pools ne Avana ke karɓa, yadda ake amincewa da su, da iyakokin da ke aiki a lokacin matakin gwaji.

Avana yana karɓar jingina ne kawai a Ethereum mainnet: zaɓaɓɓun LP tokens na Uniswap v2 da matsayin Uniswap v3. Risk Module yana tabbatar da cewa ajiya tana cikin pool na Uniswap v2 da aka amince da shi, ko pool, matakin kuɗi da kewayo na Uniswap v3 da aka amince da su. Avana yana rarraba pools zuwa rukuni uku. Har yanzu ana tantance pools ɗin da ake la'akari da su.

Amincewa tana sa pool ya cancanta. Sannan LPOracle yana ƙimanta kowane matsayi ba tare da ragi ba. Ƙarfin aron matsayin yana fitowa daga Collateral Factor na reserve. Wannan ma'auni shi ne Collateral Factor mafi ƙanƙanta na tokens biyu na ƙasa, wanda aka ninka da ma'aunin haɗarin pool. Ma'aunin haɗarin pool yana nuna kewayo, tasirin canjin farashi, zurfin pool da kuɗaɗen liquidation da ake tsammani.

Kowace kasuwa kuma tana da nata yanayin sasantawa, tsawon lokacin TWAP, karkacewar farashi da aka yarda da iyakar tsufan feed. Iyakokin Hub suna taƙaita yawan abin da kowane Borrow Spoke zai iya cirewa.

Yarjejeniyoyin abokan hulɗa na iya haɗawa da kuɗaɗen shiga na turawa (referral) ko na haɗi. Ba sa canza sharuɗɗan aro a Aave V4, sigogin haɗari, ko ƙa'idojin sasantawa. Avana bai dogara da yarjejeniyoyin kasuwanci da AMMs ba.

Yi amfani da ƙimomin LPOracle da Aave V4 abubuwan lafiyar maimakon maimaita lissafinsu a cikin fuskar haɗin gwiwa.

Ƙayyade waɗanne masu amfani za su iya samun damar shiga wurin shiga da kuma yadda mahaɗar ke bayyana canji zuwa Avana. A lokacin matukin jirgi, masu ajiya da aka ba da izini kawai za su iya yin alƙawarin matsayi.

Yadda abokan hulɗa ke haɗa masu amfani zuwa tsarin aron GHO na Avana. Ƙa'idojin aro, haɗari da sasantawa suna nan a cikin kwangilolin.

AppKit yana haɗa DEXs, walat, da manhajojin portfolio da tsarin aron GHO na Avana mai goyon bayan LP. Manhajar abokin hulɗa tana zaɓar inda mashigar za ta bayyana kuma tana miƙa walat da mahallin kasuwa na mai amfani. Aron kansa yana gudana ta Aave Adapter da Borrow Spoke na Avana a Aave V4. Kwangilolin Avana suna kula da binciken jingina da sasantawa.

AppKit haɗin frontend ne. Ba ya canza waɗanne pools aka amince da su ko yadda ake ƙimanta matsayi ko yi musu liquidation. Masu amfani kuma za su iya kiran kwangilolin kai tsaye, ba tare da AppKit ko frontend na Avana ba.

Abokan hulɗa suna sarrafa yadda ake gabatar da mashigar aro da jagororin da ke kewaye da ita. Waɗannan zaɓuɓɓuka suna shafar yadda masu amfani ke isa ga tsarin. Cancantar jingina da binciken ma'amala suna nan a cikin kwangilolin Avana da Aave V4.
Bayanan Aiwatarwa

Haɗin AppKit yana haɗa hangen wuri na yanzu da kwararar aro ta Avana da ta dace. Ayyukan aiwatarwa da ke ƙasa suna rufe saka, canja wurin mahallin, da kuma iyaka tsakanin keɓaɓɓen keɓaɓɓen mai haɗin gwiwa da ayyukan tsarin Avana.

Kafin kunna haɗin, ku tabbatar da cikakkiyar hanya daga shafin matsayi na abokin hulɗa zuwa tsarin aro na Avana. Dole ne manhajar ta bayyana asusun da aka zaɓa, kasuwa, da sauyawa zuwa Avana a sarari.

Hada wuraren shiga da aka ɓoye, hanyoyin kai tsaye, da bayanan walat, kasuwa, ko jinginar da suka ɓace a cikin wannan bitar. Wadannan lamuran suna shafar ko tsarin zai buɗe da bayanan da ake buƙata don tantance aron.
Jagorar haɗi ga masu haɓakawa don saka AppKit a cikin samfuran abokan hulɗa.

Ba a tallafawa ba. Ƙara kowanne daga cikinsu yana buƙatar bita daban da amincewar gudanarwa, ciki har da amincewa da hanyar ƙimanta farashinsa.
Yadda LPOracle ke kimanta vault tokens, da abin da Aave Adapter ke ba da izini lokacin da dubawa farashi suka gaza.

LPOracle na Avana yana ƙimanta kowane vault token daga lissafin ruwan kuɗi na pool a farashin Chainlink. Chainlink shi ne ma'aunin ƙimantawa, kuma TWAP na pool bincike ne na biyu. Ga matsayi masu tattaccen ruwan kuɗi, ana lissafa adadin tokens daga ruwan kuɗi da kewayon matsayin a farashin ma'auni.

LPOracle yana bayar da rahoton ƙimar ruwa per vault token ba tare da yanke ba. Nawa daga wannan ƙimar zai iya goyan bayan bashi ana saita shi daban, ta hanyar Kashi na Gaggawa na kowace ajiyar a kan Borrow Spoke.

Ana raba ƙimantawa da iyakokin aro. Oracle yana ba da rahoton ƙimar matsayin. Collateral Factor da ma'aunin haɗarin pool suna la'akari da kewayo, tasirin canjin farashi, zurfin pool da kuɗaɗen liquidation da ake tsammani.
Ƙimar Vault-token ta dogara ne akan:
Kowane vault token ana ƙima shi da ƙimar adadin token biyu da yake wakilta:

Sakamakon shine cikakken darajar ruwa. Ana aiwatar da gyaran haɗari ta hanyar Factor na Kwatance, ba a farashin ba.

Avana yana ayyana tushen TWAP ne kawai don Uniswap v2 da v3. Tushen TWAP na wani AMM ana ayyana shi a cikin bitar wannan AMM kuma gudanarwa ce ke amincewa da shi.

strings: Aave Adapter
Yadda Aave Adapter, mashigar mai aro zuwa Avana, ke kula da ajiya, aro, biyan bashi da cirewa ta Position Proxy na kowane mai aro.

Jinginarwa: tana matsar da LP token na Uniswap v2 ko matsayin Uniswap v3 zuwa riƙon LP Vault. Adapter yana ƙirƙirar vault tokens 1:1 ta hanyar Collateralization Module. Yana samar da su ta Position Proxy na mai aro kuma yana kunna su a matsayin jingina.
Aro: yana aron GHO daga Avana Hub ta hanyar Borrow Spoke. Shingayen TWAP da na tsohon farashi suna aiki.
Biyan bashi: yana samuwa a kowane lokaci sai dai idan an dakatar da Adapter.
Cirewa: ana ba da izini ne kawai idan asusun ya kasance cikin ƙoshin lafiya. Adapter yana ƙone vault tokens da suka dace, kuma LP Vault yana sakin LP tokens ko NFT tare da kuɗaɗen da ba a karɓa ba.
Matsayin shiga aron kuɗi don ajiya, aron kuɗi, biyan bashi da cire kuɗi, yana aiki ta hanyar wakilin Matsayin kowanne mai aro.

Aave Adapter shi ne mashigar mai aro zuwa Avana. Yana daidaita ajiya tare da LP Vault da Collateralization Module. Lokacin da aka jingina matsayi, Adapter yana ƙirƙirar vault tokens kuma yana samar da su ta Position Proxy na mai aro a matsayin jingina. Aro, biyan bashi da cirewa suma suna bi ta Adapter.

Aave Adapter ba ya tsayar da sigogin haɗari ko ƙimar jingina. Collateral Factors, binciken lafiya da cancantar liquidation suna fitowa daga Borrow Spoke, LPOracle da sigogin da gudanarwa ta amince da su. Shafuka masu alaƙa:
Borrow Spoke
Tsarin Liquidation

Keɓaɓɓen Position Proxy yana riƙe da matsayin Aave na kowane mai aro. Saboda haka kowane mataki na mai aro (ajiya, aro, biyan bashi, cirewa) yana bi ta Aave Adapter da matakan sarrafawa na Avana. Liquidation na sasantawa ta ɓangare ba ya bi ta Aave Adapter. A sasantawa ta ɓangare, LPVaultSwap yana kiran Borrow Spoke kai tsaye. A sasantawa ta cikakken matsayi, Aave Adapter yana cirewa kuma yana ƙone dukkan vault tokens na matsayin domin LP Vault ya sake shi.

Aave Adapter yana aiwatar da ƙofofin TWAP da tsufa-farashi. Idan TWAP pool ya fita daga iyaka, yana toshe sabbin aron kudi da cire kuɗi masu ƙara haɗari. Idan feed Chainlink ya tsufa ko ba daidai ba ne, yana toshe sabbin aron kudi da cire kuɗi da an yi da gangan. Biyan bashi yana ci gaba a dukkan yanayi biyu.

Ana ba da izinin cirewa ne kawai idan asusun ya ci gaba da kasancewa cikin ƙoshin lafiya bayan haka. Sannan Aave Adapter yana ƙone vault tokens da suka dace. LP Vault yana sakin LP tokens ko NFT tare da duk wasu kuɗaɗen da ba a karɓa ba.
Aave Adapter mai iya haɓakawa ne, a bayan timelock da Avana Labs ba zai iya tsallakewa ba. Ana wallafa adiresoshin kwangiloli bayan an amince da ƙaddamarwa.
Masu aro na iya kiran kwangilolin kai tsaye, ba tare da frontend na Avana ba. Suna riƙe da ikon biyan bashi da yin cire-cire da aka halatta.
Matsayin da suka yi nasara a binciken pool da iyaka na Risk Module kaɗai ne za a iya ajiyewa. Aave Adapter ba ya yanke shawarar waɗanne pools aka amince da su.
Yadda Aave Adapter ke gudanar da ayyukan mai aro ta hanyar Position Proxy na kowane mai aro.

strings: Ƙamus
Ma'anonin kalmomin protocol na Avana, ciki har da Avana Hub, Borrow Spokes, LP Vault, vault tokens, Collateral Factor, LPOracle da yanayin sasantawa.

Daidaitaccen Aave V4 Hub wanda ba a gyara ba, mallakar Aave DAO. Yana riƙe da layin bashi na GHO mai iyaka da aka ware ta hanyar GHO Reserve. Borrow Spokes na Avana da aka amince da su kaɗai ne za su iya cirewa daga gare shi.
Avana Borrow Spoke

Daidaitaccen Aave V4 Spoke mallakar Aave DAO. Yana riƙe da reserves na vault-token na jingina kawai don rukunin kasuwa guda. Yana ba da rancen GHO ƙarƙashin Collateral Factor, Collateral Risk da sigogin liquidation na kowane reserve.
Avana Lend Spoke
Aave V4 Spoke da gudanarwar Aave ke amincewa da shi daban. Yana ƙara samar da kadarori kai tsaye daga masu ba da rance zuwa Avana Hub da kuma aron kadarori ban da GHO.
Hub-da-Spoke Architecture

Zanen Aave V4 inda ruwa yake a cikin Hub kuma dokokin jingina suna a cikin Spokes. Avana yana amfani da ƙa'idojin al'ada na Aave V4 Hub da Spoke kuma yana adana dukkan ƙa'idodin musamman na Avana a cikin nasa kwangiloli.
Mai aiki da aka amince da shi wanda ke kiran LPVaultSwap don yi wa asusu marasa lafiya liquidation. Aƙalla masu gudanar da keeper biyu ne ke aiki: Avana Labs da aƙalla mai aiki ɗaya mai zaman kansa.

Matsayin ruwan kuɗi a cikin pool na AMM da ake tallafawa. Avana yana tallafa wa zaɓaɓɓun LP tokens na Uniswap v2 da matsayin Uniswap v3 a Ethereum mainnet. An taƙaita Uniswap v3 ga matsayi masu cikakken kewayo da kewayon da aka amince da su musamman.
Ajiye matsayin LP a cikin LP Vault. Jinginarwa (Pledge) tana canza mai riƙe da shi amma ba ta cire ruwan kuɗi daga pool ba.

Kwangilar Avana da ke riƙe da LP tokens da NFTs da aka jingina. Tana rubuta mai shi, kasuwa, goyon baya da halin kowane matsayi. Tana sakin matsayi ne kawai ta hanyar cirewa ko sasantawa da aka amince da ita.

Ƙuntataccen canja wuri, rikodi na ERC-20 kawai (dicimal 18) wanda ke wakiltar ƙudirin ruwa 1:1 akan Avana Borrow Spoke. Akwai vault token guda ɗaya a kowace yarda da pool, kuma kowane kewayon inda ya dace. Ba ta da mai shi, ba ta kasuwa ta biyu kuma ba ta da hayaki.
Wakilin Matsayi

Keɓaɓɓiyar kwangila da ke riƙe da matsayin Aave na kowane mai aro. Saboda haka kowace ajiya, aro, biyan bashi da cirewa tana bi ta matakan sarrafawa na Avana. A kasuwannin cikakken matsayi kuma tana ɗauke da ikon sasantawa.
Factorin tsaro
Kason ƙimar vault token da ke tallafa wa bashi: LPCollateralFactor = min(Token0CF, Token1CF) × PoolRiskFactor.
Pool Abubuwan Hadari
Raguwar kowane kasuwa da aka aiwatar sau daya ga ƙaramin Asalin Ƙimar Tabbataccen Kayan Wajo. Yana nuna yanki, jin ƙimar farashi, zurfin pool da ƙididdigar farashin siyarwa da ake tsammani.
Ƙarfin aro
LPPositionValue × LPCollateralFactor. Ƙarfin kuma yana dogara da bashi na yanzu, iyakokin fallasa, samun GHO kuɗi a hannu da binciken oracles.
Kasuwa Category

Daya daga cikin rukuni uku na kasuwannin da aka amince da su, kowanne yana da Borrow Spoke, ƙa'idodi da iyakoki: Stable LP (mai yiwuwa USDC/USDT), Correlated LP (mai yiwuwa wstETH/WETH) da Blue-chip/stable LP (mai yiwuwa WETH/USDC).
Stablecoin na Aave kuma kadara guda ɗaya tilo da masu aro za su iya aro daga Avana.
GHO Layin Bashi
Kason GHO mai iyaka daga Aave DAO zuwa Avana Hub ta hanyar GHO Reserve. Kowane ƙari yana ƙarƙashin sharuɗɗa da amincewar gudanarwa.
Adadin Lamuni
BaseRate × (1 + UserRiskPremium). Misali, ƙarin haɗari na 50% akan ƙimar tushe ta 4.5% yana ba da 6.75%.
Ƙididdigar tushe na Avana Hub GHO, wanda shine aƙalla Core Hub GHO ƙimar tushe.
Premium Risk ɗin mai amfani

Ƙimar da aka ƙara zuwa ga ƙima, wanda aka saita daga Hadarin Lamuni na jinginar mai lamuni. Tare da asusun ajiyar kuɗi da yawa, matsakaicin nauyi ne. Aave V4 sabunta shi akan rance, cirewa, canjin lamuni da buƙatu.
Hadarin jingina
Saitin kowane ajiyar a kan Borrow Spoke wanda ke ƙayyade ƙarin fa'ida na mai aro. Bai rage ƙimar jinginar ba.
health factor
Ƙimar jingina bayan Collateral Factors, wanda aka raba da bashin GHO da ba a biya ba. Ana iya yi wa asusu liquidation idan ma'aunin lafiyarsa ya faɗi ƙasa da 1.
Sasantawa ta Ƙasa

Yanayin sasantawa na Uniswap v2 da zaɓaɓɓun kasuwannin Aerodrome ko Uniswap v3. LPVaultSwap yana kiran daidaitaccen liquidation na Aave V4 da flash loan na GHO. Ruwan kuɗin da ake buƙata don dawo da lafiya kaɗai ake cirewa, don haka mai aro yana riƙe sauran matsayin.
Cikakkun Matsalolin Matsayi

Yanayin sasantawa na yawancin AMMs da ke amfani da NFTs. LPVaultSwap yana biyan bashin da flash loan kuma yana sasanta dukkan matsayin ta hanyar da aka amince da ita. Duk wata rara bayan bashi, kuɗaɗe da kashe-kashe tana komawa ga mai aro.
Kyautar Liquidation
Tushen ƙarfafawa na Aave V4 a kasuwannin sashe na biya. Yana ba da kuɗin sakon mai tsare, kuɗin aiwatarwa da kuma kuɗin ƙarshe na Avana. Ba ya aiki a cikin cikakken sassauƙar wuri.

Jari da aka keɓe don biyan asara wanda LPVaultSwap ke amfani da shi a cikin liquidation idan kuɗin da aka samu bai isa ba. Idan reserve ɗin ba zai iya biyan ƙarancin kuɗin ba, ana soke ma'amalar, kuma bashi da jingina ba su canza ba. Yana ƙirguwa ne kawai idan an saka masa kuɗi.
Hasashen Avana don vault tokens. Yana ƙididdige farashin kowanne vault token daga lissafin ruwa na pool a farashin Chainlink (VaultTokenPrice = q0·P0 + q1·P1) kuma baya amfani da ragin kudi.

Binciken daidaito ne da farashin matsakaicin lokaci na pool. Ba a haɗa shi cikin lissafin farashin ba. Idan TWAP ya fita daga iyakar da aka yarda, ana hana sabon aro da cire-cire masu ƙara haɗari. Biyan bashi da liquidation suna ci gaba a farashin Chainlink.

Mashigar mai aro zuwa Avana. Yana daidaita ajiya tare da LP Vault da Collateralization Module, sannan yana ƙirƙira kuma yana samar da vault tokens. Aro, biyan bashi da cirewa suma suna bi ta AaveAdapter. Yana aiwatar da shingayen TWAP da na tsohon farashi amma ba ya tsayar da sigogin haɗari ko ƙimar jingina.

Kwangila kaɗai da ke aiwatar da liquidations. Tana ɗaukar flash loans kuma tana gudanar da hanyar sasantawa ta kowace kasuwa. Tana amfani da FirstLossReserve idan an buƙata kuma tana biyan keepers, Avana da masu aro. Ba Spoke ba ce kuma ba za ta iya cirewa daga Avana Hub ba. Mallakar mai zartarwa na Aave DAO ce, kuma multisig na Avana Labs da masu ba da sabis na Aave DAO ne ke riƙe da ikon sarrafa ayyukanta.
Yana duba cancantar kasuwa, jerin izinin matukin jirgi, iyakoki-girman matsayi da iyakan bayyanawa a pool, alamar-tabbace da matakin ajiya.
Yana saita adadin vault-token don kowane matsayi a 1:1 da ruwa kuma yana daidaita tallafi. Ba za a iya shafar bayarwa ta oracle ba.
Kwangiloli marasa canzawa masu lambar siga waɗanda ke aiwatar da fita da aka amince da su. Suna fanshe LP tokens, cire ruwan kuɗi da karɓar kuɗaɗe.
Rike ma'anar kasuwa, taswirar kwangila, Avana - iyakoki, saitunan magana, hanyoyin sasantawa da sharuddan kuɗi.
Farashin LP
Darajar matsayi na LP da ake riƙewa a LP Vault kuma wanda vault tokens ke wakilta a Avana Borrow Spokes.
Fitaccen Bashi
Adadin GHO da aka ci bashi yanzu akan jinginar vault-token.
Amfani da Layin Bashi
Rabon layin bashi na Avana Hub na GHO da masu ara sukayi amfani da shi.
Aron Headroom
Bambanci tsakanin bashin da mai aron kudi ke da shi a yanzu da ƙarfin aron kudinsa a Borrow Spoke.
Tallafawa Sulhu
Kwatancen samar da vault-token da kwararar kuɗi na LP Vault a kowane kasuwa, wanda AaveAdapterLens ya bayar.
Amincewar Pool

Ana iya amfani da pools da aka amince da shi kawai a matsayin jingina. Sabbin jingina pools ana wallafa su don bita na makonni biyu kafin amincewar jerin. An cire meme-token pools da pools waɗanda ba su da isasshen tarihin ruwa ko farashi na waje mai dogaro.
Jerin Amincewar Matukin Jirgin Sama

A lokacin matakin gwaji, masu ajiya da ke cikin jerin izini kaɗai ne za su iya jingina matsayi. Kowace kasuwa tana da mafi ƙanƙanta da mafi girman girman matsayi, kuma kowane asusu yana da iyaka kan yawan matsayi. Gudanarwa na iya cire jerin izinin da zarar an cika sharuɗɗan matakin gwaji.
Filayen Filaye
Iyakoki da aka bincika a pool, alamar-tabbaci da matakin ajiya, gami da iyaka akan rabon pool na ruwa. Hub ƙara da zana kofuna shima yana iyakance kwarara akan Borrow Spoke.
Mai Kula da Gaggawa

Wani multisig da zai iya dakatarwa, daskarewa da soke. Ba zai iya haɓaka kwangiloli ba, canza ƙayyadaddun bayanai ko motsa jingina. Zai iya daskare kasuwa ta hanyar daskarewa duka vault-token ajiyar da GHO ajiyar a kan Borrow Spoke.
Rawar Mulki

Aave DAO ne ya mallaki Avana Hub da Borrow Spokes kuma yana riƙe da ayyukan dakatarwa da daskarewa a kan kwangilolin Avana. Yana iya tsayar da kasuwanni ba tare da Avana Labs ba. Avana Labs yana gudanar da kwangilolinsa a cikin waɗannan izini.
Haɓaka Lokacin Kulle
Jinkiri kan haɓaka kwangilolin Avana masu iya haɓakawa, wanda wa'adin aiwatarwa ke biyo baya. Avana Labs ba zai iya tsallake jinkirin ba. Aave DAO na iya soke haɓakawar da ke jira a layi.
Avana Umbrella
Avana's protocol safe module, mai suna bayan Aave's Umbrella. Shi ne na uku a cikin tsarin asara, bayan sadaukar da babban hasara na farko da kudaden shiga da aka sadaukar don ɗaukar hasara.
LP & Lantarki
Bashi & Riba
Rufi
Oracle & Kwangiloli

Avana yarjejeniya ce ta software. Wannan takaddun ba ya zama shawarar saka hannun jari ba.

Sandbox na jama'a yana amfani da kadarorin kwaikwayo kuma ba ya yin ma'amaloli onchain.
Hadarin Asara:
Masu amfani na iya rasa kuɗi ta hanyar raunin yarjejeniyar mai hankali, canjin kasuwa, asarar ɗan lokaci, tsabtacewa, ko gazawar oracl.
Matsayin Gudanarwa:
Matsayin ka'idoji na Avana da alamun sa (idan akwai) ba su da garanti kuma yana iya bambanta ta ikon hukuma.

Ciniki yana canza abin da ya ƙunsa, farashi yana canza ƙimarsa, kuma kuɗaɗe suna taruwa a tsawon lokaci. Matsayin tattaccen ruwan kuɗi kuma ya dogara da kewayonsa kuma yana iya zama na gefe ɗaya yayin da farashi ke motsi.

Saboda haka Avana yana tsayar da sigogin haɗari bisa kowace kasuwa. Kowane pool da aka amince da shi (da kewayo, inda ya dace) yana da nasa vault token. Kowace kasuwa tana da nata ma'aunin haɗarin pool, yanayin sasantawa, tsawon lokacin TWAP, karkacewar farashi da aka yarda da iyakar tsufan feed. Kowane ɗaya daga cikin rukunin kasuwa uku (Stable LP, Correlated LP da Blue-chip/stable LP) yana da nasa Borrow Spoke, sigogi da iyakoki.

Masu amfani suna jingina LP token na Uniswap v2 ko matsayin Uniswap v3 da aka amince da shi ga LP Vault. Jinginarwa (Pledge) tana canza mai riƙe da shi amma ba ta cire ruwan kuɗi ba, don haka matsayin yana ci gaba da samun kuɗaɗe. Matsayin Uniswap v3 yana daina samun kuɗaɗe yayin da yake a wajen kewayonsa.
Collateralization Module yana ƙirƙirar vault tokens 1:1 da ruwan kuɗin da aka jingina. AaveAdapter yana samar da su ga Borrow Spoke na Avana na kasuwar ta Position Proxy na mai aro.
Sannan mai aro yana aron GHO daga Avana Hub. Borrow Spoke yana aiwatar da sigogin haɗari na vault-token, kuma Hub yana riƙe da ruwan kuɗin GHO da lissafin bashi.

LPOracle yana ƙimanta kowane vault token daga lissafin ruwan kuɗi na pool. Yana fitar da adadin tokens da ke bayan kowane vault token kuma yana ƙimanta su a farashin Chainlink: VaultTokenPrice = q0·P0 + q1·P1. Ga Uniswap v3, adadin yana fitowa daga ruwan kuɗi da kewayon matsayin a farashin ma'auni.
Oracle ba ya aiwatar da ragi. Collateral Factor na kowane reserve yana kula da haɗari daban, kuma Collateral Risk yana tsayar da ƙarin ribar mai aro.

Chainlink shi ne ma'aunin ƙimantawa. TWAP na pool binciken daidaito ne. Ba a haɗa shi a matsakaici cikin farashin ba kuma ba ya maye gurbin Chainlink. Idan TWAP ya fita daga iyakar da aka yarda, ana hana sabon aro da cire-cire masu ƙara haɗari. Biyan bashi da liquidation suna ci gaba a farashin Chainlink.

Ƙarfin aro shi ne ƙimar matsayin wanda aka ninka da Collateral Factor na reserve: LPCollateralFactor = min(Token0CF, Token1CF) × PoolRiskFactor. Ana amfani da ma'aunin haɗarin pool sau ɗaya. Yana nuna kewayo, tasirin canjin farashi, zurfin pool da kuɗaɗen liquidation da ake tsammani.

Ƙarfin aro kuma ya dogara ne da bashin da ake da shi, iyakokin fallasa, ruwan kuɗin GHO da ake da shi da binciken oracle. Ƙimar ribar aro ita ce BaseRate × (1 + UserRiskPremium). Idan akwai reserves na jingina da yawa, ƙarin ribar matsakaicin ma'auni ne.
Misalin bayani na yadda ake samun factor na kowane reserve yana cikin
Collateral Factor
Abun lafiyar yana kwatanta ƙimar jinginar, bayan kowane Yanayin Jinginar ajiyar, tare da bashi mai fita GHO. Asusun yana zama cancanta don kashewa lokacin da abun lafiyarsa ya faɗi ƙasa da 1.

Keepers da aka amince da su kaɗai ne za su iya kiran LPVaultSwap. LPVaultSwap yana ɗaukar flash loan na GHO, yana biyan bashin kuma yana sasanta jinginar LP a cikin ma'amala ɗaya. Uniswap v2 da wasu kasuwannin Uniswap v3 suna amfani da sasantawa ta ɓangare, wadda ke cire ruwan kuɗin da ake buƙata don dawo da lafiya kaɗai. Kasuwannin da cirewa ta ɓangare ba ta dace da su ba suna amfani da sasantawa ta cikakken matsayi, wadda ke mayar wa mai aro duk wata rara.

Matsayin da aka jingina suna nan a cikin pool kuma suna ci gaba da samun kuɗaɗen ciniki. Matsayin Uniswap v3 yana samun kuɗaɗe ne kawai yayin da yake cikin kewayonsa. Lokacin da mai aro ya cire, LP Vault yana sakin LP tokens ko NFT tare da duk wasu kuɗaɗen da ba a karɓa ba. Ana ba da izinin cirewa ne kawai idan asusun ya kasance cikin ƙoshin lafiya.
Takardu masu alaƙa:
Oracle na Farashi
Kudin LP
Muhimman ra'ayoyi game da jingina matsayin LP, ƙimanta vault token, Collateral Factors da aron GHO a Avana.

Sharuɗɗan Sabis

waɗanda suka shafi masu haɓaka manhaja (developers). Taƙaitawa ce, ba madadin Sharuɗɗan ba ce ko gyara gare su. Samun dama ko amfani da Ayyuka yana nufin karɓar Sharuɗɗan, ciki har da gyare-gyaren da ke fara aiki da zarar an wallafa su. Cikakkun Sharuɗɗan ne ke ayyana yarjejeniyar da ke tsakaninku da Avana. Ku koma gare su don ainihin kalmomi, sharuɗɗa, da keɓewa.

Avana yana ba da ayyukan fasaha, ciki har da yanayin gwaji, manhajar yanar gizo, da kayan bayanai. Protocol ɗin ya ƙunshi kwangiloli masu wayo na buɗaɗɗen tushe (open-source) waɗanda za su iya karɓa da riƙe kadarorin crypto da ake tallafawa. Sashe na 2 yana bambanta waɗannan kwangiloli da Ayyuka (Services) kuma yana bayyana cewa amfani da kwangilolin yana kan haɗarin mai amfani. Avana ba ya sarrafa manhajojin ɓangare na uku da aka gina a kan protocol ɗin ko ayyukan masu amfani da ke mu'amala da shi.

Fuskar ba ta riƙe maɓallan masu zaman kansu, ba ta sarrafa dukiya a madadin mai amfani, kuma ba ta canza ko juyar da ma'amalolin blockchain da aka mika ba. Wannan ya bambanta da ajiyar kuɗi a cikin kwangilar tsarin, inda kwangilar ke riƙe jingina bisa ƙa'idodinta. Sashe na 3.2 kuma ya tanadar da hakkin Avana na cajin ko canza kuɗin fuska. Duba
Sashe na 2 da na 3

Takardu, koyarwa, maƙaloli, da sauran kayan aiki suna bayyana tsarin don manufar bayani da ilimi. Ba sa maye gurbin kimantawa mai zaman kanta ta haɗi ko shawarar kuɗi. Sharuɗɗan sun bayyana cewa ƙila ba su zama cikakken tushe ko tushe kaɗai na bayanai ba. Avana ba ya aiki a matsayin dillali, mai ciniki, kasuwar musaya, mai ba da shawarar zuba jari, mai riƙo, ko mai ba da sabis na kuɗi, kuma ba ya ɗaukar wani nauyin amana ga masu amfani. Sashe na 4 yana magana kan dogaro da waɗannan kayan aiki da alhakin asarar da ke da alaƙa da su.

Samun dama yana ƙarƙashin ƙa'idojin cancanta da takunkumi a Sashe na 1. Masu amfani suna da alhakin wajibai na shari'a da haraji da suka shafe su, kare maɓallan walat, da ma'amaloli da aka sa hannu da waɗannan maɓallan. Sashe na 5 da na 11 sun hana shiga ba tare da izini ba, katsalandan, yawan buƙatu na cin zarafi, da haɗe-haɗe masu ɓatarwa. Walat, protocols, da ayyuka na ɓangare na uku suna da nasu sharuɗɗa, kuɗaɗe, ayyukan sirri, da haɗari. Waɗannan suna aiki ma lokacin da aka yi amfani da su ta hanyar haɗin Avana.

Samuwar lamba ba ta ba kowane ɓangare na Ayyuka lasisi iri ɗaya ba. Sashe na 6 yana bayyana lasisin Ayyuka, hani kan alamomin Avana, da yadda ake kula da ra'ayoyi (feedback). Inda wani ɓangaren software ke da lasisi na open-source ko business-source daban, Sashe na 6.2 ya tanadi cewa lasisin wannan ɓangaren ne ke mulkinsa. Saboda haka dole ne haɗi ya yi la'akari da sharuɗɗan kowane ɓangaren da yake amfani da shi, da kuma ƙa'idojin samun damar Ayyuka.

Sharuɗɗan sun bayyana protocol da abubuwan da ya dogara da su a matsayin fasahar gwaji. Raunin kwangila, haɓakawa, gazawar network, hare-haren intanet, da katsewar sabis na iya sa ma'amaloli su gaza ko kadarori su ɓace. Kadarori da networks masu jituwa na iya canzawa. Manhajar ba ta cire waɗannan haɗari ba, kuma misali ko sakamakon gwaji a cikin takardun ba ya tabbatar da cewa ma'amala ta gaba tana haifar da sakamako iri ɗaya. Kwangilolin Avana suna cikin bitar tsaro ta cikin gida kuma ba a yi musu binciken tsaro mai zaman kansa ba. Binciken tsaro na jama'a masu zaman kansu za su biyo baya. Ƙaddamarwa tana buƙatar waɗannan binciken tsaro, gyare-gyare, da amincewar gudanarwar Aave.

Aro mai goyon bayan LP ya dogara ne da ƙimar matsayin da ke ƙasa. Motsin kasuwa, abubuwan da pool ya ƙunsa, bayanan oracle, da ruwan kuɗin liquidation na iya shafar ƙimar jingina da lafiyar asusu. Masu aro har yanzu suna ɗaukar asarar wucin gadi, haɗarin farashi da haɗarin liquidation. Idan ma'aunin lafiyar asusu ya faɗi ƙasa da 1, ana iya sasanta wani ɓangare ko dukkan matsayin LP ɗinsa don biyan bashi, gwargwadon yanayin sasantawa na kasuwar. Waɗannan hanyoyin aiki suna bayyana yadda haɗarin protocol zai iya shafar haɗi. Ba sa taƙaita manyan haɗari da alhakin masu amfani da aka bayyana a cikin
Sashe na 8

Testnet na wanzu ne don gwaji da inganta haɗin kai. A ƙarƙashin Sashe na 3.1, alamun gwaji ba su da ƙima a kuɗi a wajen Testnet kuma ba za a iya fansa su ko canza su zuwa kuɗi na zahiri, kadarorin crypto na samarwa, ko wasu ƙima ba. Avana na iya canza, dakatar, ko daina dukko ko wani ɓangare na Testnet ba tare da sanarwa ba. Balances ɗin gwaji da sakamako suna bayyana yanayin gwaji ne, ba iƙirarin kadarori ko tabbatar da daidaiton aikin samarwa ba. Sandbox ɗin jama'a a app.avana.cc yana amfani da kadarori na kwaikwayo, baya yin ma'amaloli a kanchain, kuma ba shaida bane na shiri don samarwa.

Sashe na 9.1 yana samar da Ayyuka bisa ga yanayin “kamar yadda yake” da “kamar yadda yake akwai,” sai dai idan an bayyana hakan a cikin Sharuɗɗan. Yana musanta garanti kai tsaye, wanda aka iya zato, da na doka, ciki har da dacewa da wani dalili na musamman, dacewar kasuwanci, rashin take hakki, da aiki ba tare da katsewa ko kuskure ba. Inda doka ta dace ta hana a cire garanti ko sharadi, Sharuɗɗan suna iyakance yaduwa da tsawon lokacin sa zuwa mafi ƙarancin iyaka da wannan doka ta yarda da shi.

Sashe na 9.2 ya keɓe wasu nau'o'in diyya da aka ƙayyade, ciki har da diyya ta sakamako, ta kaikaice, ta haɗari, da ta musamman, bayanan da suka ɓace, ribar da aka rasa, da raguwar ƙima. Ya kuma taƙaita jimillar alhakin Avana ƙarƙashin Sharuɗɗan zuwa US$100. Sashe na 9.3 ya bayyana cewa wasu keɓewa ko iyakoki ƙila ba za su yi aiki ba a yankunan shari'a da ba su ba da izinin su ba. Ku karanta waɗannan tanade-tanaden tare da sharuɗɗa da keɓewar da ke cikin Sharuɗɗan.

Sashe na 9.4 yana bayyana alhakin biya diyya, kare kai, da maido da kudi don da'awoyi da suka shafi amfani da Ayyuka ko ayyukan wasu, karya Ka'idoji, kayan da aka aika, da sauye-sauye ko amfani ba bisa ka'ida ba. Cikakken ikon, bangarorin da abin ya shafa, da hanyoyin suna bayyana a
Sashe na 9
. Wannan takaitaccen bayanin bai faɗaɗa ko maye gurbin waɗannan wajibai ba.

Sashe na 10 ya fayyace sulhu mai ɗaurewa ƙarƙashin hanyoyin JAMS da aka bayyana a cikin Sharuɗɗan, tare da sulhu a New York, New York. Ya haɗa da sanarwa akalla kwanaki 30 kafin buƙatar sulhu, tanade-tanade don magance matsaloli na ɗan lokaci, da kuma kawar da ƙarar rukuni da shari'ar alkali, bisa ga sharuɗɗan da aka bayyana da dokar da ta dace. Idan abincin Chainlink ya tsufa kuma farashin da aka ajiye ya wuce mafi yawan shekarunsa, an dakatar da sayar da kaya har sai abincin ya farfado ko kuma gwamnati ta amince da abinci madadin. Biya zai ci gaba.

Alkaluman misali ne kuma ba sigogin kasuwa ba ne. Ana ɗaukar cewa ƙimar GHO da USDC $1 ce. Gudanarwa ce ke tsayar da kyautar liquidation, ma'aunin lafiya da ake nufi da iyakokin kuɗaɗe ga kowace kasuwa.

Mai aro yana jingina matsayin WETH/USDC mai cikakken kewayo na $100,000. Mai aron yana karɓar raka'ar tushe ɗaya ta vault-token a kowace raka'ar ruwan kuɗi, wanda jimillar ƙimarsa ta kai $100,000. Collateral Factor mafi ƙanƙanta tsakanin tokens biyu na ƙasa shi ne 70%, kuma ma'aunin haɗarin pool shi ne 50%, don haka LP Collateral Factor shi ne 35%.
• Adadin rance shine 35,000 GHO.
• Iyakacin fuska a lokacin buɗe factor lafiya na 1.10 yana kimanin 31,800 GHO.
• Mai aro ya karɓi 25,000 GHO, don samun farkon matakin lafiya na 1.40.
• Matsayin lafiya yana kaiwa 1.00 lokacin da kudin jinginar ya kai kusa da $71,400, wani faduwa na kusan 29%.
• Sannan jingina ya sauka zuwa $70,000 kuma tsarin lafiya zuwa 0.98, don haka asusun ya cancanci a yi masa rushewa.
Tare da kari na kashi 5% na lalacewa da kuma maƙasudin lafiyar 1.05, biyan bashin lalacewa na Aave V4 kawai yana biya bashin da ya isa don dawo da maƙasudin.
• LPVaultSwap yana ɗaukar aron kuɗi na ɗan gajeren lokaci na GHO kuma yana biya kusan 2,564 GHO na bashi.
• Kusan $2,692 na ruwa, ƙasa da kashi 4% na matsayin, an cire shi daga pool kuma an musanya zuwa GHO.
• Kyautar tana biyan ladan keeper, kuɗaɗen aiwatarwa da kuɗin Avana mai iyaka. Kuɗin liquidation na cikin Aave 0 ne ga reserves na vault-token.
• Mai aro yana riƙe da kusan $67,300 na jinginar abu don biyan bashi na 22,436 GHO, don samun ma'aunin lafiya na 1.05.
A kasuwar cikakken matsayi, ana sasanta wannan matsayin gaba ɗaya kuma ana mayar da rarar ga mai aro. Kyautar liquidation ta Aave ba ta aiki a wannan yanayin.
• LPVaultSwap yana aro na ɗan lokaci na 25,000 GHO kuma yana biya bashi ta hanyar ikon warwarewa na Wakilin Matsayi.
• Aave Adapter yana cirewa kuma yana ƙone dukkan vault tokens. Sannan LP Vault yana sakin matsayin don sasantawa ta hanyar da aka amince da ita.
• Biya ya kai 69,000 GHO.
• Ana biyan flash loan. Ladan keeper, kuɗaɗen aiwatarwa da kuɗin Avana sun kai jimillar GHO 750, cikin iyakar kaso na bashi na kasuwar.
• Mai aro yana karɓar saura 43,250 GHO.

Mai aro na iya riƙe fiye da reserve ɗaya na vault-token a matsayin jingina a kan Borrow Spoke. Aave V4 yana lissafa ma'aunin lafiya guda ɗaya ga asusun, amma sasantawa tana gudana matsayi bayan matsayi bisa yanayin sasantawa na kowace kasuwa.

Aave V4 Layer

Avana Borrow Spoke, wata ƙa'ida ta Aave V4, tana bibiyar bashi, vault-token jinginar da lafiyar kuɗi. A kasuwannin sashe-sashe ta gudanar da Aave V4's tsarin sayarwa na al'ada, ciki har da manufa ta lafiyar kuɗi da ƙa'idodin ƙura.
LPVaultSwap Layer

LPVaultSwap yana ɗaukar flash loan kuma yana fara liquidation ko sasantawa. Yana ƙone vault tokens da aka ƙwace kuma yana amfani da FirstLossReserve idan an buƙata. Sannan yana biyan keepers, Avana da masu aro. LPVaultSwap ba Spoke ba ne kuma ba ya aro daga Avana Hub.
LP Vault da matakin sasanci

LP Vault yana cire ruwan kuɗi da ya dace ko yana sakin matsayin don sasantawa. Adaftocin sasantawa na AMM suna fanshe LP tokens kuma suna cire ruwan kuɗi. Suna kuma karɓar kuɗaɗe da aiwatar da fita da aka amince da su. Ana canza kuɗin da aka samu zuwa GHO ta CoW Swap a cikin ma'amalar liquidation.
Hanyoyin sayar da kaya na ruwa Aave V4 suna haɗa lissafin kuɗi na abin jinginar vault-token zuwa matsayin LP da aka riƙe a cikin LP Vault. Dokokin da ke ƙasa suna kiyaye daidaito tsakanin su biyu.
Kowane vault token an goyi bayan sa
Vault tokens ana ƙera su 1:1 tare da kuɗin da aka ajiye kuma ana ƙone su lokacin janye ko daidaita. Kowace vault token da ke wanzu tana goyan bayan kuɗi a cikin LP Vault.
An ƙone abin da aka kwace vault tokens
Lokacin da aka kwace ko cire vault tokens don biyan diyya, LPVaultSwap yana kona su kuma LP Vault yana cire ko sakin daidaitaccen ruwa a cikin aikin ma'amala guda ɗaya.
Wata mu'amala
Bashi na gaggawa, biyan bashi, cire ruwa, musayar zuwa GHO da biyan bashin gaggawa duk suna kammala a cikin ma'amalar kashe-haja. Idan wani mataki ya gaza, ma'amalar zata koma baya.
Rashin cika ana rufewa ko ciniki yana dawowa
Idan abin da aka samu ya gaza, LPVaultSwap yana zana daga FirstLossReserve a cikin wannan ciniki. Idan ajiyar ba zai iya rufe gibin ba, ciniki ya koma baya kuma bashi da lamuni ba su canzawa.

Kowace kasuwa tana da yanayin sasantawa da aka amince da shi. LP tokens na Uniswap v2 masu musanyawa ne kuma ana iya fanshe su ɓangare-ɓangare. Sasantawa ta ɓangare tana shafar Uniswap v2 da zaɓaɓɓun kasuwannin Aerodrome ko Uniswap v3. A waɗannan kasuwannin Aerodrome da Uniswap v3, ana iya cire wani ɓangare na ruwan kuɗi yayin da NFT ke nan a cikin LP Vault.
Sasantawa ta cikakken matsayi tana shafar yawancin AMMs da ke amfani da NFTs. Ƙara kowane AMM daban yana buƙatar nasa bita da amincewar gudanarwa.
Matakan suna dogara ne akan yanayin biyan kudi na kasuwa.
Sasantawa ta wani ɓangare
• LPVaultSwap yana ɗaukar aron kudi na ɗan lokaci GHO kuma yana kiran tsarin lalata na Aave V4, wanda ke amfani da ka'idar lafiyar manufa da dokokin ƙura.

• LPVaultSwap yana karɓa kuma yana ƙone vault tokens da aka ƙwace. Sannan LP Vault yana cire ruwan kuɗi da ya dace. Ga Uniswap v3, yana cire wani ɓangare na ruwan kuɗi kuma NFT yana nan a cikin vault. Ga Uniswap v2, yana fanshe LP tokens da suka dace. Ana musanya kuɗin da aka samu zuwa GHO kuma ana biyan flash loan.
• A al'ada, ruwan kuɗin da ake buƙata don dawo da lafiya kaɗai ake cirewa, kuma mai aro yana riƙe sauran. Ƙa'idar ƙura (dust) na iya yi wa ƙaramin saura liquidation gaba ɗaya.
Cikakken matsayi daidaitawa
• LPVaultSwap flash-borrows GHO kuma yana biya bashi ta hanyar ikon sulhu na Wakar Matsayi.
• Aave Adapter yana cirewa kuma yana ƙone dukkan vault tokens na matsayin. Sannan LP Vault yana sakin NFT don sasantawa ta hanyar da aka amince da ita.
• Idan matsayin shine kawai jinginar asusun, za a biya bashin gaba ɗaya. In ba haka ba, za a daidaita biyan bisa ga burin lafiya da aka amince da shi.
• Ragowar bayan bashi, kudade da farashi ana mayarwa ga mai ba da bashi. Kyautar Aave liquidation ba ya aiki a wannan yanayin.
Kafin liquidation, matsayin yana cikin LP Vault kuma yana nan a cikin pool ɗinsa. Vault tokens ɗinsa suna da cikakken goyon baya daga wannan ruwan kuɗi.

Liquidation yana gudana a cikin ma'amala guda, don haka ba a taɓa barin matsayi an sasanta shi rabi ba. Ko dai sasantawa ta kammala, ko kuma a soke ma'amalar, bashi da jingina su kasance ba tare da canji ba.

Bayan wani sashe na biyan basus, mai karbar aron yana riƙe da ragowar matsayin da vault tokens ɗinsa. Bayan cikakken biyan matsayi, duk vault tokens don matsayin ana ƙona su kuma duk wani rabo yana zuwa ga mai karbar aron.

A kasuwannin sasantawa ta ɓangare, kyautar liquidation ta Aave V4 tana biyan ladan keeper, kuɗaɗen aiwatarwa da kuɗin liquidation na Avana mai iyaka. An saita kuɗin liquidation na cikin Aave zuwa 0 ga reserves na vault-token. Saboda haka ana cajin kuɗin protocol sau ɗaya, a cikin LPVaultSwap, a matsayin ƙayyadadden kaso na kyautar, kuma ba ya ƙara wa mai aro kuɗi. A kasuwannin cikakken matsayi, ana cire ladan keeper, kuɗaɗen kashewa da kuɗin Avana daga kuɗin da aka samu, har zuwa iyakar kaso na bashi na kowace kasuwa. Rarar tana zuwa ga mai aro. Gudanarwa ce ke tsayar da ƙimomin kyauta, kuɗi da iyaka na kowace kasuwa.

Idan kuɗin da aka samu bai isa ba, LPVaultSwap yana amfani da FirstLossReserve a cikin ma'amala ɗaya. Idan reserve ɗin ba zai iya biyan ƙarancin kuɗin ba, ana soke ma'amalar, kuma keepers na iya sake gwadawa da ƙaramin liquidation na ɓangare. Ana kunna aro ne kawai da zarar an samar da tsarin warware irin waɗannan matsayi. Aave V4 yana rubuta giɓi a Avana Hub ne kawai lokacin da daidaitaccen liquidation na Aave V4 da aka kammala ya cinye jingina alhali bashi ya rage.

Keepers da aka amince da su kaɗai ne za su iya kiran LPVaultSwap. Aƙalla masu gudanar da keeper biyu ne ke gudanar da liquidations: Avana Labs da aƙalla mai aiki ɗaya mai zaman kansa. Buɗe liquidation ga masu liquidation na ɓangare na uku yana buƙatar amincewar gudanarwa.
Keepers suna sa ido kan ma'aunin lafiya da Aave V4 ke lissafawa daga farashin LPOracle da Collateral Factor na kowane reserve.
Kowane mataki, daga rancen walƙiya zuwa biyan lamuni mai walƙiya, yana ƙarewa cikin ma'amalar ruwa.
Bashin haske yana fitowa daga GHO FlashMinter akan Ethereum.
Ana canza kuɗin da aka samu zuwa GHO ta CoW Swap. Kowace hanya tana kammaluwa a cikin ma'amalar liquidation.
Yadda liquidation ke tafiya daga cancanta a Aave V4 idan ma'aunin lafiya ya gaza 1 zuwa sasantawa ta LPVaultSwap a yanayin sasantawa ta ɓangare ko sasantawa ta cikakken matsayi.

Bincika Borrow Spoke

Avana yana kawo matsayin ruwan kuɗi na AMM zuwa Aave V4 a matsayin jingina. Mai ajiya yana jingina LP token na Uniswap v2 ko matsayin Uniswap v3 ga LP Vault. Sannan mai ajiyar yana aron GHO daga Avana Hub yayin da matsayin ke nan a cikin pool.

Don aro a kan kadarorin LP a wani wuri, mai samar da ruwan kuɗi yawanci sai ya fara cirewa daga pool. Cirewa yana sa a rasa kuɗaɗen ciniki da, ga matsayi masu tattaccen ruwan kuɗi, kewayon da aka zaɓa.

Avana yana riƙe da matsayin a cikin pool ɗinsa. LP Vault yana riƙe da matsayin, kuma vault token yana wakiltarsa a Borrow Spoke na Avana. Vault token rikodin ERC-20 ne na jingina kawai wanda aka taƙaita canja wurinsa, kuma yana daidai 1:1 da ruwan kuɗin da ke ƙasa. Avana yana aiki a Ethereum mainnet tare da zaɓaɓɓun kasuwannin Uniswap v2 da v3.

Kowane mataki yana haɗa wani aiki na mai amfani da lissafin protocol. Jinginarwa (Pledge) tana kafa riƙo. Ƙimantawa da Collateral Factor suna tantance ƙarfin aro. Aro yana haifar da bashin GHO a kan wannan ƙarfin aro. Jagororin da ke biye suna bayyana kowane mataki dalla-dalla.

Jinginar LP tana bai wa kadarorin da aka riga aka saka a AMM damar tallafa wa bashin GHO. Amfanin shi ne sassaucin jari, ba tabbacin riba mai kyau (positive carry) ba. Masu aro har yanzu suna ɗaukar asarar wucin gadi, haɗarin farashi da haɗarin liquidation.

Avana Hub da Borrow Spokes na Avana daidaitattun kwangilolin Aave V4 ne waɗanda ba a gyara ba, mallakar Aave DAO. Dukkan lambar aiki da ta keɓanta ga Avana tana cikin kwangilolin Avana na kansa: LP Vault, AaveAdapter, LPOracle, RiskModule, CollateralizationModule, LPVaultSwap, AMMSettlementAdapters da AvanaConfig.

Kowane rukunin kasuwa (Stable LP, Correlated LP da Blue-chip/stable LP) yana da nasa Borrow Spoke na Avana, sigogi da iyakoki. Avana Hub yana riƙe da layin bashi na GHO, kuma Borrow Spokes da aka amince da su kaɗai ne za su iya cirewa daga gare shi. Keɓaɓɓen Position Proxy yana riƙe da matsayin Aave na kowane mai aro. Saboda haka ajiya, aro, biyan bashi da cirewa suna bi ta matakan sarrafawa na Avana. Lend Spoke na Avana yana bai wa masu ba da rance damar samar da kadarori kai tsaye ga Avana Hub. Gudanarwar Aave tana amincewa da shi daban.
Taƙaitaccen bayani kan Avana: jingina matsayin Uniswap LP, aron GHO daga Avana Hub, da ƙa'idojin kowace kasuwa na ƙimantawa da liquidation.

Idan kuɗin da aka samu daga liquidation bai biya bashin da ake biya ba, LPVaultSwap yana amfani da FirstLossReserve a cikin ma'amala ɗaya. Idan reserve ɗin ba zai iya biyan ƙarancin kuɗin ba, ana soke ma'amalar kuma bashi da jingina ba su canza ba. Keepers na iya sake gwadawa da ƙaramin liquidation na ɓangare. Aave V4 yana rubuta giɓi a Avana Hub ne kawai lokacin da daidaitaccen liquidation na Aave V4 da aka kammala ya cinye jinginar asusu alhali bashi ya rage. Liquidation da aka soke ba ya haifar da giɓi, kuma bashin yana nan a kan asusun. Avana Hub daidaitacciyar kwangilar Aave V4 ce mallakar Aave DAO. Borrow Spokes da aka amince da su kaɗai ne ke da ikon cire GHO daga gare shi.

Mataki na farko shi ne keɓaɓɓen jarin asarar farko da ake riƙewa a kwangilar FirstLossReserve. Ana tsayar da girmansa tare da masu ba da sabis na Aave DAO. Reserve ɗin yana ƙirguwa a matsayin kariya ne kawai da zarar an saka masa kuɗi. Alƙawari kaɗai ba kariya ba ne.

LPVaultSwap yana amfani da FirstLossReserve kai tsaye yayin liquidation, don haka ana amfani da jarin asarar farko kafin wani giɓi ya kai ga Avana Hub. Rahotannin wata-wata na Avana sun ƙunshi albarkatun asarar farko.
Asarar ana ɗauka cikin wani tsari na dindindin. Ana amfani da kowane mataki kafin na gaba.
1. Jari na farko na asara da aka kebe (FirstLossReserve) 2. Kuɗaɗen shiga da aka sadaukar don rufe asara 3. Avana Umbrella

Girman kowane mataki, da waɗanne kuɗaɗen shiga aka keɓe don biyan asara, ana tsayar da su tare da masu ba da sabis na Aave DAO kuma gudanarwa tana amincewa da su. Dukkan kuɗaɗen shiga na riba da suka danganci layin bashi na GHO suna taruwa ga Aave DAO.

Ana biyan ƙarancin kuɗin da aka gano yayin liquidation daga FirstLossReserve a cikin ma'amala ɗaya, ko kuma a soke liquidation ɗin. Giɓin da aka rubuta a Avana Hub bayan an kammala daidaitaccen liquidation ana biyan shi bisa tsarin ɗaukar asara da ke sama.
Fallasar Aave DAO ta taƙaitu ga layin bashi na GHO mai iyaka. Kowane ƙari ga layin bashin yana buƙatar amincewar gudanarwa. Gudanarwa ce ke ayyana ainihin matakan sasantawa don biyan giɓin Hub.

Avana Umbrella shi ne mataki na uku na tsarin ɗaukar asara kuma an sanya masa suna bisa Umbrella na Aave. Ba a fayyace yadda yake aiki ba tukuna, ciki har da waɗanne kadarori za a iya ajiyewa (stake), sharuɗɗan lada, iyakokin yanke kaso (slashing) da lokutan jira na cirewa. Amincewar gudanarwa ta daban ce ke tsayar da su. Adiresoshin token, lokutan jira da sigogin Aave v3 Umbrella ba saitunan tsoho ba ne ga Avana.

Layin bashi na GHO yana girma a matakai. Kowane mataki yana da nasa sharuɗɗa kuma yana buƙatar amincewar gudanarwa. Jarin da aka saka kuɗi kaɗai ke ƙirguwa a matsayin kariya, kuma ana cire adadin da aka kashe yayin liquidation daga kariyar da ke akwai. Biyan asara yana shafar giɓin GHO a Avana Hub. Rahotannin amfani na mako-mako da rahotannin kuɗaɗen shiga na wata-wata suna bai wa masu karatu damar kwatanta kariya da fallasa. Rahotannin sun ƙunshi mummunan bashi, amfani da FirstLossReserve, amfani da layin bashi da albarkatun asarar farko. Sun kuma ƙunshi liquidations da suka yi nasara, suka gaza da aka sake gwadawa.

Biyan asara yana shafar ƙarancin kuɗi da giɓi na protocol. Ba ya biyan masu aro diyya, waɗanda har yanzu suke ɗaukar asarar wucin gadi, haɗarin farashi da haɗarin liquidation. Biyan asara ya taƙaitu ga jarin da ke akwai a zahiri. Ba ya ƙara ƙarfin aro ko cire haɗarin liquidation. An bayyana matakan sarrafawa da tsarin farfaɗowa da ke aiki kafin biyan asara a cikin

Farashin Chainlink yana da inganci, TWAP ya fita daga iyakar da aka yarda: ana hana sabon aro da cire-cire masu ƙara haɗari. Biyan bashi da liquidation suna ci gaba a farashin Chainlink.
Chainlink ya tsufa ko ba shi da inganci, farashin da aka adana yana cikin iyakar tsufansa: ana amfani da farashi na ƙarshe mai inganci. Ana hana sabon aro da cire-cire na son rai.
Farashin da aka adana ya wuce iyakar tsufansa: liquidations suna tsayawa har sai feed ya dawo ko gudanarwa ta amince da feed na ajiya. Biyan bashi yana ci gaba.

Fitar da kasuwa daga jeri (offboarding): ana daskare sabon aro. Biyan bashi da cirewa suna ci gaba, kuma ana iya yi wa matsayi marasa lafiya liquidation.
Ƙarancin kuɗin liquidation da FirstLossReserve ba zai iya biya ba: ana soke ma'amalar kuma bashi da jingina ba su canza ba.

Tsarin Haɗari
Yadda ayyukan gudanarwa, timelock na haɓakawa da ikon sarrafawa na gaggawa ke aiki a kan Avana Hub, Borrow Spokes da kwangilolin Avana na kansa.

Avana Hub da Borrow Spokes daidaitattun kwangilolin Aave V4 ne waɗanda ba a gyara ba, mallakar Aave DAO. Lambar aiki da ta keɓanta ga Avana tana cikin kwangilolin Avana na kansa: LP Vault, AvanaConfig, Risk Module, Collateralization Module, LPOracle, adaftocin sasantawa na AMM, Aave Adapter da LPVaultSwap.

Avana yana da rukunin pool uku: stable, correlated da blue-chip/stable. Kowane rukuni yana da nasa Borrow Spoke, sigogi da iyakoki. Kowace kasuwa kuma tana da nata ma'aunin haɗarin pool, yanayin sasantawa da saitunan oracle.

Ɓangarori uku ne ke riƙe da iko daban-daban: Aave DAO, Avana Labs da multisig na Emergency Guardian. Avana Labs yana gabatarwa da gudanar da canje-canje, kuma wani keɓaɓɓen mai bitar haɗari yana bitar su. Aave DAO yana amincewa da canje-canje kuma yana iya tsayar da kasuwanni. Guardian na iya dakatarwa, daskarewa da sokewa ne kawai.

Iyakan ikon gaggawa

Ikon gaggawa na iya dakatarwa ko taƙaita ayyuka ne kawai. Masu aro har yanzu za su iya biyan bashi da yin cire-cire da aka halatta ta hanyar kiran kwangilolin kai tsaye, ba tare da frontend na Avana ba.

Avana Labs ne ya mallaki, yake gudanarwa kuma yake biyan kuɗin kwangilolinsa, binciken tsaro, sa ido da keepers. Fallasar Aave DAO ta taƙaitu ga layin bashi na GHO mai iyaka. Kowane ƙari ga layin bashin yana buƙatar amincewar gudanarwa.
